remarks: Welcome to this beautifully renovated 3 bedroom, 3 full bathroom home located on a peaceful dead-end street. This move-in ready property features a spacious and functional layout with modern updates throughout. Enjoy a finished walk-out basement offering additional living space perfect for a family room, home office, or guest area.  The home has been thoughtfully updated with brand new central A/C and heating, and upgraded 200-amp electrical service for comfort and efficiency. Step outside to a good-sized deck ideal for entertaining or relaxing.  Conveniently located within walking distance to the train station, this home is perfect for commuters while still offering privacy and tranquility.
